crossRefs.note: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

translations.web: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
translations.bsb: Men will go there with bow and arrow, for the land will be covered with briers and thorns.
translations.kjv: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
translations.asv: With arrows and with bow shall one come thither, because all the land shall be briers and thorns.
